conventions.coordinate_action: fractional column coordinates x' = A q + t/24
conventions.parameters: q = (x, y, z); repeated or absent symbols encode constrained coordinates
conventions.centering: representative maps are expanded by the separately stored centering translations
conventions.rhombohedral: Hall choices H and R follow spglib; H uses the obverse hexagonal cell and R the primitive rhombohedral cell
conventions.origin_and_axes: the Hall symbol and spglib choice define the origin and axis setting; no implicit conversion is applied
